title: Monster Special Edition
content:
This entry is a hard one to come by in the Monster franchise. At some point, I almost thought it was lost media. If not for a kind person on the first episode’s discussion.

For the above reason, I’ll include some light spoilers for those who had no luck finding it in the wild. Although, there is no spoiling a recap, let’s be honest. And I guess it goes without saying that if you have not already seen the full parent show, this is not for you.

Other than the parent series, there has only been two complimentary releases in Monster’s name. Two of them being recaps,which is a bummer.

The other recap entry “Monster Extra: Hottan” only manages to recap the first portion of the story, in contrast, this one recaps the entire story from start to finish, across two episodes.

The first episode starts by reciting the whole Goblin fairytale in Nina’s voice, as it transitions to the first events of the story, building up until the moment when Dr. Tenma, Johan and Nina meet at the scene engulfed in fire. Spanning around 54 minutes. I’d say it’s a respectable amount of time for the content it covers.

The second episode picks up from the encounter of Dr. Tenma and Grimmer up until the final moments of the story. However, it takes a whopping 1 hour and 53 minutes to get the point through. Considerably longer than the first episode, feeling more like a movie, however, it covers arguably the better portion of the story, so the length is actually justified in my unbiased eyes. It focused immensely on the twins’ backstory and the Ruhenheim massacre arc.

I don’t know if it’s subject of there release or the copy I came across, but I noticed the visuals did not look as good as they did in the parent show. A. bit grainy and blurry, almost lower resolution I could have sworn. Other than that. It’s a solid recap that yes, does overlook some parts of the story, but it does a fine job outlining the story.

Overall: 7.24/10.
